"达标" : "不达标", })) const toneFor = (type: string, key: string) => data.confusions.filter((c) => c.affected.includes(type)).map((c) => String(c[key])) const confusionColumns = [ { key: "where", label: "位置", span: 3 }, { key: "colors", label: "颜色对", span: 2 }, { key: "normal", label: "正常", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "protan", label: "红色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("红色盲", "红色盲") }, { key: "deutan", label: "绿色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("绿色盲", "绿色盲") }, { key: "tritan", label: "蓝色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("蓝色盲", "蓝色盲") }, ] const confusionRows = data.confusions.map((c) => ({ where: c.where, colors: c.colors.join(" / "), normal: c.normal, protan: c["红色盲"], deutan: c["绿色盲"], tritan: c["蓝色盲"], })) const issueColumns = [ { key: "title", label: "问题", span: 3 }, { key: "place", label: "位置 · 类型", span: 3 }, { key: "severity", label: "严重", span: 1, tone: ["高"] }, { key: "affects", label: "影响", span: 2 }, ] const issueRows = data.issues.map((i) => ({ title: `${i.id} · ${i.title}`, place: `${i.location} · ${i.type}`, severity: i.severity, affects: i.affects.join("、") || "—", })) const fixColumns = [ { key: "where", label: "位置", span: 2 }, { key: "from", label: "原色", span: 2 }, { key: "to", label: "改为", span: 2 }, { key: "bg", label: "背景", span: 1 }, { key: "before", label: "改前", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "after", label: "改后", align: "right", span: 1 }, ] const fixRows = data.fixes.map((f) => ({ where: f.where, from: f.from, to: f.to, bg: f.bg, before: f.before, after: f.after, })) const steps = data.issues.map((i) => ({ title: i.title, description: i.suggestion })) const facts = [ { label: "分析对象", value: data.target }, { label: "分析日期", value: data.date }, { label: "判定标准", value: data.standard }, { label: "分析方法", value: data.method }, ] return (
